review_evidence: README presents the repository as “A journey to the world of Numbers,” and the seven formal modules are devoted to naturals, integers, rationals, order, and reals.

Numbers/naturals.lean develops a custom natural-number type with addition, multiplication, predecessor, cancellation and algebraic laws; Numbers/integers.lean constructs integers by quotienting pairs and proves ring/order properties.

The unit-wide declaration inventory found about 292 definitions/theorems/lemmas, including add_assoc, mul_comm, i_injective, le_total and archimedean, so the source is substantive foundational mathematics.
summary: Retain Numbers: it reconstructs natural numbers, integers, rationals, reals, algebraic operations, order, and their laws in Lean.
